notes: Every use is an attribution of FB4's dace parameter set. The intermediary agrees: FB4 (Deslauriers et al. 2017, p. 4, Table 1, and its parameter file Deslauriers_etal_2017_Parameters_official.csv, row "Dace (adult & juvenile), Phoxinus spp.") gives the source as "He 1986; Trudel and Boisclair 1994", and the code's minnow set (CA 0.36, CB −0.31, CQ 2.3, CTO 26, CTM 29, RA 0.0148, RB −0.2, RQ 2.1, RTO 29, RTM 32) matches that row. Which parameters each paper supplied, and the fish and conditions behind them (the hybrid Phoxinus eos × P. neogaeus of Quebec lakes), stay unchecked until the article is read; the title says it compared field consumption with the model's estimates, so it may also report the dace model's bias, which the paper's surrogate notes would want.
